Installed-source introspection of MOABB 1.2.0 reports filters [[8, 32]], tmin 0.0, tmax None, resample None, channels None, baseline None, reject None, and events left_hand/right_hand.

verified_detail: Trial records preserve dataset key, subject_id, session_id, run_id, trial_id, raw_label, and canonical_label from MOABB metadata.
paper_language: Each extracted trial is aligned with subject, session, run, and label metadata.

verified_detail: Subjects are sorted, shuffled with Python Random(seed), and split by subject with an 80 percent default train fraction while forcing non-empty train/test subject sets.
paper_language: Cross-subject evaluation holds out subjects, so no subject appears in both task-model train and test splits.
follow_up: For final PhysioNet claims, add random subject-subset validation rather than relying only on sequential widening.

verified_detail: Sessions are sorted, shuffled with Python Random(seed), and one session is assigned to train while the remaining session(s) are assigned to test.
paper_language: Cross-session evaluation trains on one session and tests on held-out session data from the same subjects.
follow_up: Confirm session naming/order from generated manifests if reporting per-session details.

verified_detail: Runs are sorted, shuffled with Python Random(seed), and one run is assigned to train while the remaining run(s) are assigned to test.
paper_language: Cross-run evaluation trains on one recording run and tests on held-out run data from the same subjects.
follow_up: Use this for PhysioNet protocol-sensitivity checks because MOABB exposes one session but repeated run IDs for the left/right imagery trials.

verified_detail: Deep models cast features to float32 and normalize using per-channel mean/std estimated only from the post-validation training subset.
paper_language: Deep-model inputs are standardized using training-subset statistics and then applied to validation and test trials.
follow_up: None; this is pinned in local code.

verified_detail: A stratified validation subset is drawn from task-model training indices using validation_fraction=0.2 by default.
paper_language: Deep models use an internal stratified validation split for early stopping.
follow_up: Report validation_fraction if describing training details.

verified_detail: Default training uses 20 epochs, batch size 32, Adam learning rate 1e-3, and early-stopping patience 5.
paper_language: Unless otherwise stated, EEGNet-family task models use 20 requested epochs, batch size 32, learning rate 1e-3, and early stopping on validation loss.
follow_up: When writing final tables, prefer result JSON epochs_trained over requested epochs.

verified_detail: The compact EEGNet uses F1=8, depth_multiplier=2, F2=16, temporal/depthwise/separable-style convolutions, ELU activations, average pooling, dropout p=0.25, and a linear classifier.
paper_language: We use a compact EEGNet-style convolutional decoder with dropout and optional bottleneck/noise/regularization variants.
follow_up: If space allows, include a concise architecture table rather than prose-only architecture details.

verified_detail: CSP-LDA defaults to n_components=8, CSP(reg=None, log=True, norm_trace=False), and scikit-learn LinearDiscriminantAnalysis.
paper_language: The classical baseline is CSP followed by LDA with eight CSP components unless otherwise specified.

verified_detail: Subject-identification probes are restricted to cross_session, fit LogisticRegression(max_iter=2000), and evaluate subject prediction from frozen task-model embeddings or CSP features.
paper_language: Subject-identification leakage is measured by a linear probe on frozen features in the cross-session setting.
follow_up: Do not apply subject-ID conclusions to PhysioNet cross-subject runs without a separate protocol.

verified_detail: For EEGNet-family membership inference, task-model train plus validation trials are members and held-out test trials are nonmembers.
paper_language: Membership inference distinguishes task-model train/validation trials from held-out test trials.
follow_up: Make this member definition explicit because validation trials are included as members.

verified_detail: Threshold attacks support label_known_log_probability, max_probability, and negative_entropy scalar scores and select the best threshold on the evaluation set.
paper_language: Threshold attacks use scalar confidence scores and report AUC, average precision, and best-threshold balanced accuracy.
follow_up: Mention that best-threshold balanced accuracy is an attack diagnostic, not a deployment protocol.

verified_detail: Learned logistic-regression and MLP attacks use posterior probabilities with or without a true-label one-hot feature; member and nonmember sets are split 50/50 into attack-train and attack-eval partitions.
paper_language: Learned attacks train separate classifiers on task-model posterior features and evaluate on held-out attack examples.
follow_up: For final claims, keep learned(logistic) and learned(mlp) families separate because rankings differ.
